_meta.method: Each of the three user-supplied short links was resolved again and its redirect target recorded. The three Amazon product pages were re-read. The official Associates policy pages, the public commission statement, the Amazon Conditions of Use and the FTC disclosure page were re-read and the exact wording compared against what the site publishes. _meta.result: All three links still resolve to the stored ASINs. All nine stored competitor ASINs reappeared in the stored order with the same titles, so the one label that had been left blank was filled from a verbatim read. Every policy citation re-read on this pass matched the site's wording. Session arena/13dd55ca-zone4 reached the same finding on main (PR #38) and blanked the product-level cells; this session independently reached the same conclusion and adopted that resolution rather than re-litigating it. One wrong flag cross-reference (F-37) was also found and corrected, and F-30 was resolved.

It blanked the product-level commission cells and rewrote the narrative; this session had independently reached the same conclusion about the rate and the same wording for the narrative, so the branch was reset to origin/main and only this session's non-overlapping findings were re-applied: the competitor label, the F-27/F-29 correction, the F-30 resolution, the derived KPIs and the rendered competitor labels. contradictions_found_and_corrected.where: docs/products.html commission cells versus the index KPI, the executive-summary headline and bullet, finding A-05, pipeline stages PL-5/PL-6 and tracking row TR-5
contradictions_found_and_corrected.problem: The product table published '4.50% (Kitchen band)' on all three rows. Amazon's public Standard Commission Income Statement Table 1 does list 'Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive' at 4.50%, so the category-level figure is official; what no official source states is the commission category Amazon assigns to each of these three ASINs. Table 1 also carries a 'Home' band at 3.00%. Placing the Kitchen figure on a product row applied a category-level rate to an individual item without an official source for that step. Meanwhile the rest of the site said the opposite: the index KPI read '0 of 3 Commission rates verified', the executive-summary headline said commission rates are not published, a bullet said the schedule was behind an Amazon sign-in, and A-05 said 'The category rate is unverified'.
contradictions_found_and_corrected.correction: Adopted from main (PR #38, session arena/13dd55ca-zone4) and confirmed independently by this session: the official category-level Kitchen rate of 4.50% is stated in the narrative with its source, and the product-level rate cells are left blank until Amazon confirms each ASIN's commission category. The index KPIs are now computed from data/products.json and data/marketing.json rather than typed in, so they cannot drift from the tables again.
